articles.summary: Water, life’s most essential resource, touches every aspect of our lives. We recognize that water is an essential resource, vital for health, food production, and so much more – but in many parts of the world, clean water access is not as easy as just turning on a tap. This World Water Day and every day, we recognize the critical need for clean water, while acknowledging that global water challenges affect everyone, but not equally, especially impacting women and girls.
articles.title: Championing Water Access: World Water Day
